items.q: They invited us to the Savoy one Sunday to paly against Fess William.

brass. And people thought that this was a band from out West, you know. And when we went to the Savoy, we played -- They invited us to the Savoy one Sunday to paly against Fess William. And everybody was astonished to find out that this band was a colored band and had been in town for about a month playing over at a radio station, and they never had seen a picture or anything, you know.
